No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced. B8TCAE adds portable actual-owner regression evidence from unchanged ICU78.3 compiled witnesses, retaining pinned source/archive/witness SHA256 values in native-observation fixtures. Public constructor/clone/field/time/limit and original protected-hook callers cover all18 calendar owners; actual RuleBasedTimeZone rule graphs include gap/fold enum options; EraRules uses genuine immutable resources; Calendar factory overloads use real cache/locale/timezone owners. This is bounded test evidence, not full native ABI/thread/allocator/whole-module parity. Runtime code and all broad semantic status fields remain unchanged; unresolved100 coverage gaps remain explicit.
